    Class
    Description
    CheckedRunnable
    A functional interface similar to Runnable, except that it declares a checked exception, and similar to Callable except that it returns void.
    SerialServerSocket
    A serial server socket listens for incoming socket connections and ensures all inputs from them are processed one at a time on a single thread.
    SerialSocket
    A serial socket ensures its setup, input, and shut down events all run one at a time on the same thread as other sockets created by the same SerialServerSocket even if an exception is thrown.
    SimpleSerialServerSocket
    A SerialServerSocket that uses a ServerSocket to accept basic Sockets, reads and writes to those sockets using text, and separates incoming and outgoing messages with new line characters.
    SimpleSerialSocket
    A SerialSocket that reads and writes messages as text and separates messages with new line characters.
